item.title: Global review confirms mRNA vaccines are safe, effective and full of promise
item.description:
📝 Health & Medicine Billions of doses later: Global review confirms mRNA vaccines are safe, effective and full of promise Comprehensive review brings together global evidence to strengthen public trust and counter misinformation as mRNA vaccines expand to prevent and treat more diseases. “This review affirms that mRNA vaccines are a safe and highly effective platform, supported by rigorous testing and real-world monitoring. ” Building trust through evidence The researchers emphasize that, like all vaccines, mRNA vaccines can have side effects.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ubc.ca/2026/06/mrna-vaccines-are-safe-effective-and-full-of-promise/

item.title: The <Usermedia> HTML Element
item.description:
📝 The <geolocation> element provides a location object to your site, and <usermedia> manages the entire flow for camera and microphone access. Why use the <usermedia> element. Direct stream access: As a data mediator, the element exposes the media stream directly.
🔗 Read more: https://developer.chrome.com/blog/usermedia-html-element

item.title: Opening up 'Zero-Knowledge Proof' technology to promote privacy in age assurance
item.description:
📝 Open sourcing these powerful cryptographic tools will make it much easier for private and public sector developers to build their own privacy-enhancing applications and digital ID solutions, meeting an urgent need. Businesses and other relying organizations of all sizes can easily leverage this open source solution to meet their privacy needs. With our commitment to making these ZKP tools openly available, Member States can integrate this into their future EUDI Wallets, accelerating their development.
